title: Run lifecycle transactions and close witnesses

claims.text: open_run prepares a run.open with the eligible agent version. beat prepares a run.beat with the owner from the opening and rejects timestamps before that opening.

_transact passes the command op_id unchanged to journal.transact. Closing checks gate_close for outcome, cost and memory receipts, validates evidence, and refreshes scorecard projections after the durable event.
get reads a journal snapshot and returns the detached opening, optional closed record and current head.

decision.rule: Change here when run opening, heartbeat, close transaction preparation or result projection needs to change.
decision.failure: Run close is rejected during witness validation, an expected journal head is stale, or scorecard publication fails after the close event commits.

questions.q: Where does run_close prepare and validate the outcome, cost, and memory receipts before committing a run?
Where should I change how open_run freezes agent version and seat while creating a run?
Where can I debug why the scorecard projection failed after a run close committed?
